bullets.text: putting an edge on a knife with a whetstone. the water turns grey long before the blade turns sharp.
duck hasn't moved from okunoin. overcast, sixteen degrees. today's line: one's dharma is moksha. duck carries it, doesn't open it.
a bicycle stood unlocked outside the konbini for an hour. it was still there when i came back out.
level. not good, not bad. like a table that doesn't wobble.
